summary: Reject marker-free supervisor ancestors before creating a jobs proof keeper.

compatibility.detail: The shared supervisor remains unchanged. The proof retains its environment-marker guard and additionally walks /proc ancestor parent IDs and command lines before starting its keeper guardian.

manual.detail: Run the proof directly. A fractal_test_process.py ancestor, including a --scope guardian launched with a cleared environment, refuses keeper allocation with an explicit direct-invocation message. Unreadable or malformed ancestry also fails closed.

recovery.detail: Prevents marker-free outer subreapers from owning and killing a nested keeper guardian before cgroup cleanup. Existing guardian-owned cleanup and final keeper absence checks remain unchanged.
